lines.text: Many learners say: I listen music every day.
Better: I listen to music every day.
To! I listen to music every day.

data.right: I listen to music every day.

native.tip: En español “escucho música”, pero en inglés “listen” necesita “to”: “listen to music.”
native.caption: 🙈 Error común: “I listen music every day.” El verbo “listen” siempre va con “to”: “I listen to music every day.” ¡Escucha a Carlos y repite! Practica más en la app Lexkite.
native.comment: Respuesta: “to”. Después de “listen” va “to” antes de lo que escuchas. Escribe una frase tuya con “to” o dila en voz alta: {link}

en.tip: Learners say “escucho música”, but “listen” needs “to” in English.
en.caption: Common mistake: “I listen music every day.” The verb “listen” always takes “to”: “I listen to music every day.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
